predecessors.name: Unified Silla
predecessors.text: the south-west (Jeolla) that Kyŏn Hwŏn seized from Silla in 892

successors.name: Goryeo
successors.text: all of Later Baekje, conquered by Goryeo

ledger.x: 900: Kyŏn Hwŏn proclaims himself king of Later Baekje.
927: Kyŏn Hwŏn attacks the Silla capital.
c.928: Later Baekje takes Jinju from Silla.

wars.name: Later Baekje's expedition to Daeya Fortress
wars.outcome: 'Kyŏn Hwŏn sent another major expedition to Taeya Fortress in 920'; no land is recorded as changing hands.

wars.name: Later Baekje attack on Gyeongju
wars.outcome: Kyŏn Hwŏn sacked Gyeongju, killed King Gyeongae and put Gyeongsun on the throne; Taejo was beaten near Daegu.

wars.name: Goryeo conquest of Later Baekje
wars.outcome: After the 935 coup against Kyŏn Hwŏn, he and Wang Kon led a Goryeo army that ended the kingdom in 936.

certainty.note: The pages give no boundary for any year; the western and southern edges are the coast, the others approximate.
